```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{Relax}{$u$}
  \ForAll{\((u,v,w)\in Adj[u]\)}
    \If{\(v\in closed\)} \State \textbf{continue} \EndIf
    \State \(tentative\gets g[u]+w\)
    \If{\(tentative&lt;g[v]\)}
      \State \(g[v]\gets tentative;\ parent[v]\gets u\)
      \State insert \((g[v]+h(v),\,g[v],\,v)\)
    \EndIf
  \EndFor
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
